_about: Feat loop batch 3, lane b3-arcane (2026-11-26): the arcane class-feature hooks a
playable class can use (the sorcerer's bloodline by feat, the druid's wild empathy) and
the spell-hook and metamagic leftovers of batches 1-2. Text read on aonprd.com
